subject.title: [Bug 6.1] Silent config auto-patch from memory-core + error-message auto-fix breaks all cron jobs on hosts without Docker

question: Should OpenClaw remove protected config-setting guidance from assistant/model-visible sandbox errors, guard CLI config writes launched through agent exec/plugin cron paths, or do both?
rationale: Current source still exposes protected sandbox config suggestions, but the reported automatic writer is not identified; choosing copy-only hardening versus CLI/plugin mutation guardrails is a security-boundary and product-behavior decision.

options.title: Define the boundary first
options.body: Treat this as a security review item, decide which surfaces may suggest or perform protected config writes, then implement the approved guardrails.

options.title: Land copy-only hardening
options.body: Remove protected config assignments from assistant-visible sandbox errors while leaving CLI config patch behavior unchanged and keeping this issue open for broader provenance work.

options.title: Wait for a full repro
options.body: Decline code changes until a current-main automatic writer is reproduced, accepting that current sandbox hints remain visible.

recommendation.title: Define the boundary first
recommendation.body: Treat this as a security review item, decide which surfaces may suggest or perform protected config writes, then implement the approved guardrails.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is primarily the gateway/model-to-operator config mutation boundary, and this person introduced the current protected gateway config-write guard.
